name: Caveman Toolkit
name_zh: Caveman 省 token 工具包
description: Token economy for coding agents from the caveman project (skills face only, MIT): ultra-compressed response mode (lite/full/ultra/wenyan), compressed commits and code review, memory-file compression with backups, session token stats, and a three-role delegation crew.
description_zh: 省 token 工具包（JuliusBrussee/caveman，仅技能面 MIT）：超压缩回复模式（lite/full/ultra/文言）、压缩版提交与代码评审、记忆文件压缩（带备份）、会话 token 统计与 cavecrew 三角色委派。
